context: Big Cyrus's cart, 34th & Seventh. Steam, onions.

lines.speaker: npc.cart_vendor
lines.text: Thirty-five cents. For a dollar, I'll tell you what I saw this morning.

lines.speaker: npc.cart_vendor
lines.text: Two plainclothes on the Lacy's corner since nine. They're not shopping.

lines.speaker: npc.cart_vendor
lines.text: Come back next week. I see everything from behind this umbrella.
